canonicalGeometry.inverseBodyPaint: literal U geometry uses photographed original white pigment exposure on dark machine surface; favicon background tile omitted; no improvised glyph

methods.opening: native original letter and same metal-face points, forward-backward optical flow, RANSAC full affine surface mapping; geometry preserved before actual source perspective
methods.timelapse: source B glyph top and left stroke edges measured independently in each real rotating body pose; actual sudden timelapse turning retained
methods.paint: original photographed pigment samples transfer nonuniform local light/reflections; native lens defocus applied; saturated approved B pink clip shares source pigment lighting
methods.erase: only old B footprint and photographed optical blur fringe; local source-only image inpainting, no generative reconstruction
methods.occlusion: selected source company marks visually exposed; body boundaries and source perspective checked at keyframes; no new machinery/scene

v25Diagnosis.confirmed: axis-aligned independently sized rectangles and fixed shears ignored actual surface orientation; quantized width/height changes altered glyph scale
v25Diagnosis.retractedInference: large wide-right location jumps are genuine real timelapse machine body rotation, not evidence of wrong identity; source contact sheet wide-right-source-all.png demonstrates correspondence
